CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (key text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, value text NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliations (id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, transfer_no text NOT NULL, branch text NOT NULL, driver text NOT NULL, doc_date text NOT NULL, payload text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL, created text NOT NULL, updated text NOT NULL, version integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, revision_token text NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reconciliations_transfer_no_unique ON reconciliations (transfer_no)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transfer_keys (key text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, group_id text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoice_keys (key text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, group_id text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_transfer_archive (id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, created text NOT NULL, destination_id text NOT NULL, source_record text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lieutenant_queue (transfer_no text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, doc_date text NOT NULL, payload text NOT NULL, source_file text NOT NULL, created text NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lieutenant_cancellation_decisions (transfer_no text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, decision text NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN ('ignore','linked','keep')), related_type text NOT NULL, related_number text NOT NULL, note text NOT NULL, revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at text NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lieutenant_opening_stock (snapshot_date text NOT NULL, warehouse text NOT NULL, sap_code text NOT NULL, item_name text NOT NULL, unit text NOT NULL, quantity real NOT NULL CHECK(quantity >= 0), source text NOT NULL, approved_at text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_date, warehouse, sap_code, unit))
